```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load the required packages and define user-controlled input and output paths.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  cache.path = file.path(
    here::here("results", "cache", "publication_pipeline"),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "/")
  )
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)
})

publication_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(publication_dir, "publication_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)

# Define input and output paths.
project_dir <- here::here()
download_dir <- params$download_dir
results_dir <- params$output_dir
input_rds <- file.path(download_dir, "olfactory_lineage.rds")
output_rds <- file.path(results_dir, "cleaned_for_slingshot_60265.rds")
output_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "plots", "lineage_cleaning")
marker_output_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "markers")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(marker_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Set random seeds for reproducible dimensionality reduction and clustering.
pca_seed <- 42L
umap_2d_seed <- 42L
cluster_seed <- 0L
umap_3d_seed <- 12345L
```


```{r marker-lists}
# Define marker lists used to label the two lineage-processing passes.


lineage_marker_list <- list(
  GBC = c("Kit", "Ascl1", "Mki67"),
  HBC = c("Krt5", "Trp63", "Krt14"),
  INP = c("Ebf1", "Ebf2", "Neurog1", "Neurod1"),
  iOSN = c("Gap43", "Neurod1", "Lhx2"),
  mOSN = c("Omp", "Adcy3", "Stoml3", "Gnal"),
  Sus = c("Cyp2g1", "Cyp2a5", "Sec14l3", "Il33"),
  MV = c("Pou2f3", "Ascl3", "Trpm5", "Gfi1b"),
  Tuft_MV = c("Trpm5", "Rgs13", "Plcb2", "Alox5ap"),
  Bowmans = c("Sox9", "Wfdc18")
)

off_lineage_marker_list <- list(
  RE_like = c("Reg3g", "Krt15", "Krt13"),
  Immune = c("Lyz2", "Cd74", "S100a8", "Srgn"),
  Stromal = c("Col1a1", "Col1a2", "Dcn", "Pdgfra"),
  Goblet = c("Tff2", "Muc5b"),
  Ionocyte = c("Cftr", "Foxi1"),
  Neuronal_Contam = c(
    "Myt1l", "Tubb3", "Gap43", "Ebf1",
    "Ebf2", "Lhx2", "Sox11", "Bach2"
  )
)



```

# Read, label, and remove the original Bowman’s/Tuft-MV clusters

These labels come from the lineage-stage resolution-0.6 clustering.

```{r small-group-cleaning}
# Load the lineage object and remove small contaminating groups before reclustering.
if (exists("filtered_seurat_lineageb")) {
  lineage <- filtered_seurat_lineageb
} else {
  lineage <- readRDS(input_rds)
}

cluster_map <- c(
  "0" = "iOSN 2",
  "1" = "mOSN 3",
  "2" = "mOSN 1",
  "3" = "iOSN 3",
  "4" = "mOSN 2",
  "5" = "iOSN 1",
  "6" = "late INP",
  "7" = "GBC",
  "8" = "Sus",
  "9" = "HBC",
  "10" = "early INP",
  "11" = "MV",
  "12" = "Bowmans",
  "13" = "Tuft MV"
)

lineage$cluster_name <- unname(
  cluster_map[as.character(lineage$RNA_snn_res.0.6)]
)
lineage$lineage_cluster_name <- lineage$cluster_name

if (anyNA(lineage$cluster_name)) {
  stop("At least one RNA_snn_res.0.6 cluster was not present in cluster_map.")
}

print(
  DimPlot(
    lineage,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "cluster_name",
    label = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE
  )
)

small_groups <- c("Bowmans", "Tuft MV")
lineage$small_group_status <- ifelse(
  lineage$cluster_name %in% small_groups,
  "Removed",
  "Retained"
)

print(
  DimPlot(
    lineage,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "small_group_status"
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(Removed = "grey75", Retained = "#1b9e77")
    )
)

lineage_no_small_groups <- subset(
  lineage,
  subset = !(cluster_name %in% small_groups)
)


```

# First processing pass and high-resolution cluster-57 identification

```{r first-processing-pass}
# Run the first processing pass and label cell states from marker scores.
first_pass_drop_cols <- grep(
  "^(RNA_snn_res\\.|score_|offscore_)",
  colnames(lineage_no_small_groups@meta.data),
  value = TRUE
)

lineage_for_reclustering <- lineage_no_small_groups
lineage_for_reclustering@meta.data <-
  lineage_for_reclustering@meta.data[
    ,
    setdiff(
      colnames(lineage_for_reclustering@meta.data),
      first_pass_drop_cols
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

rm(lineage_no_small_groups)
invisible(gc())

lineage_reclustered <- process_lineage_object(
  lineage_for_reclustering,
  resolutions =c(0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 4)
)
lineage_reclustered <- add_umap3d(lineage_reclustered)
lineage_reclustered <- score_and_label_lineage(lineage_reclustered)

rm(lineage_for_reclustering)
invisible(gc())

cluster_selection_summary <- lineage_reclustered@meta.data %>%
  mutate(cluster_id = as.character(RNA_snn_res.4)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    frac_sus = mean(refined_celltype == "Sus", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_iOSN = mean(refined_celltype == "iOSN", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_mOSN = mean(refined_celltype == "mOSN", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_INP = mean(refined_celltype == "INP", na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_neuronal_contam = mean(
      offscore_Neuronal_Contam,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_neuronal_contam = median(
      offscore_Neuronal_Contam,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(frac_sus >= 0.5) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(mean_neuronal_contam),
    desc(frac_sus),
    desc(n_cells)
  )

print(cluster_selection_summary)
selected_cluster_id <- cluster_selection_summary$cluster_id[1]

if (!identical(selected_cluster_id, "57")) {
  stop(
    "Expected high-resolution cluster 57, but selected cluster ",
    selected_cluster_id,
    "."
  )
}

cluster57_n <- sum(
  as.character(lineage_reclustered$RNA_snn_res.4) ==
    selected_cluster_id
)
stopifnot(cluster57_n == 394L)
```

# Plot and remove the neuronal-like Sus cluster

```{r neuronal-like-removal, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
# Remove the neuronal-like cluster before the final processing pass.
lineage_reclustered$neuronlike_status <- ifelse(
  as.character(lineage_reclustered$RNA_snn_res.4) ==
    selected_cluster_id,
  "Neuron-like Sus",
  "Other cells"
)

highlight <- DimPlot(
  lineage_reclustered,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "neuronlike_status"
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neuron-like Sus" = "#e41a1c",
      "Other cells" = "grey80"
    )
  )

score_umap <- FeaturePlot(
  lineage_reclustered,
  features = "offscore_Neuronal_Contam",
  reduction = "umap",
  order = TRUE
)

print(highlight | score_umap)

# The comparison population is the original lineage-stage Sus annotation.
sus_meta <- lineage_reclustered@meta.data %>%
  filter(cluster_name == "Sus") %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      as.character(RNA_snn_res.4) == selected_cluster_id,
      "Neuron-like cluster",
      "Other Sus clusters"
    ),
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c("Neuron-like cluster", "Other Sus clusters")
    )
  )

print(table(sus_meta$group))

neuron_violin <- ggplot(
  sus_meta,
  aes(
    x = group,
    y = offscore_Neuronal_Contam,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = FALSE, adjust = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neuron-like cluster" = "#e41a1c",
      "Other Sus clusters" = "#80b1d3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Neuronal module score") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(neuron_violin)

lineage_no57 <- subset(
  lineage_reclustered,
  subset = RNA_snn_res.4 != selected_cluster_id
)

stopifnot(ncol(lineage_no57) == 60943L)
```

# Count Sus cells before and after cluster-57 removal.

```{r before-after-by-age, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
# Compare age composition before and after contaminant removal to document its effect.
if (!"sample" %in% colnames(lineage_reclustered@meta.data)) {
  lineage_reclustered$sample <- tolower(
    sub(
      "^.*?([Pp][0-9]+).*$",
      "\\1",
      as.character(lineage_reclustered$orig.ident)
    )
  )
}
lineage_no57$sample <- lineage_reclustered$sample[colnames(lineage_no57)]


age_counts <- bind_rows(
  summarise_sus(lineage_reclustered, "Before removal"),
  summarise_sus(lineage_no57, "After removal")
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = factor(
      sample,
      levels = c("p1", "p3", "p5", "p8", "p15", "p22")
    )
  )

sus_count_plot <- ggplot(
  age_counts,
  aes(sample, sus_cells, color = stage, group = stage)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Sus cells", x = NULL, y = "Number of cells") +
  theme_minimal()

sus_percent_plot <- ggplot(
  age_counts,
  aes(sample, sus_percent, color = stage, group = stage)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Sus percentage",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of cells"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(sus_count_plot | sus_percent_plot)

write.csv(
  age_counts,
  file.path(marker_output_dir, "sus_removal.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Second processing pass and marker-based cleanup

The first-pass clustering and scores must be discarded before the remaining
60,943 cells are processed again. The second filter is based on the newly
calculated `refined_celltype`; it is not based on a cluster numbered 12.

```{r second-processing-pass}
# Run the second processing pass and create the labels used by Slingshot.
second_pass_drop_cols <- unique(c(
  grep(
    "^(RNA_snn_res\\.|score_|offscore_)",
    colnames(lineage_no57@meta.data),
    value = TRUE
  ),
  "refined_celltype",
  "refined_celltype_score",
  "refined_celltype_gap",
  "broad_clusters",
  "small_group_status",
  "neuronlike_status"
))
second_pass_drop_cols <- intersect(
  second_pass_drop_cols,
  colnames(lineage_no57@meta.data)
)

lineage_no57@meta.data <- lineage_no57@meta.data[
  ,
  setdiff(colnames(lineage_no57@meta.data), second_pass_drop_cols),
  drop = FALSE
]

rm(lineage_reclustered, sus_meta)
invisible(gc())

lineage_reprocessed <- process_lineage_object(
  lineage_no57,
  resolutions = c(0.4, 4.0)
)
lineage_reprocessed <- add_umap3d(lineage_reprocessed)
lineage_reprocessed <- score_and_label_lineage(lineage_reprocessed)

rm(lineage_no57)
invisible(gc())

stopifnot(ncol(lineage_reprocessed) == 60943L)

secondary_exclusion_flag <-
  lineage_reprocessed$refined_celltype %in% c("Bowmans", "Tuft_MV")

secondary_exclusion_counts <- table(
  factor(
    lineage_reprocessed$refined_celltype[secondary_exclusion_flag],
    levels = c("Bowmans", "Tuft_MV")
  )
)

print(secondary_exclusion_counts)

expected_secondary_exclusions <- c(Bowmans = 664L, Tuft_MV = 14L)
if (!identical(
  as.integer(secondary_exclusion_counts),
  as.integer(expected_secondary_exclusions)
)) {
  stop(
    "Unexpected secondary exclusions. Expected Bowmans=664 and ",
    "Tuft_MV=14; observed ",
    paste(
      names(secondary_exclusion_counts),
      as.integer(secondary_exclusion_counts),
      sep = "=",
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "."
  )
}

trajectory_cells <- colnames(lineage_reprocessed)[
  !secondary_exclusion_flag
]
lineage_clean <- subset(
  lineage_reprocessed,
  cells = trajectory_cells
)

stopifnot(sum(secondary_exclusion_flag) == 678L)
stopifnot(ncol(lineage_clean) == 60265L)

# Preserve the original detailed lineage labels and the new marker-based broad
# labels needed by the downstream Slingshot analysis.
stopifnot("cluster_name" %in% colnames(lineage_clean@meta.data))
stopifnot("lineage_cluster_name" %in% colnames(lineage_clean@meta.data))
stopifnot("broad_clusters" %in% colnames(lineage_clean@meta.data))
```
